text:
jana: Quick check for the weekly KPI slide deck — post-launch benchmark looks odd. Webinar signups up 32% but demo-booking rate fell from 4.8% -> 2.3%. Can analytics + growth confirm whether it's attribution, lead quality, or the nurture sequence? Link: https://app.redwood.com/dash/weekly-launch

liam: Noticed that too. Initial pass: a large cohort is tagged `linkedin_org` with low email_verified. Could be scraped contacts. :confused:

numbers-bot: snapshot created (snap_id=7744) for weekly-launch at 2026-06-03T14:12:01Z.

sophie: Running a cohort pull now. Headline: total signups (72h)=3,640; webinar-attrib=2,920; linkedin_org=420; organic_linkedin=300; unverified_emails across linkedin_org ~78%.

kevin: Hypothesis: the LinkedIn outreach automation we turned on for the benchmark post appended tracking params that our pipeline mis-parsed, defaulting to `linkedin_org` for any malformed utm_campaign. That would inflate signups but lower true intent. Tagging growth-automation to inspect the outreach job.

liam: Also saw that the post-launch nurture email #1 has a broken CTA for some mobile clients (link missing UTM). People hit the site but don't hit booking funnel properly. That'll push conversions down.

sophie: SQL I used to sample: ```SELECT id, email, source, utm_campaign, email_verified, created_at FROM leads WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '72 hours' AND (source LIKE '%linkedin%' OR utm_campaign IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;```

kevin: Action items: 1) growth-automation will pause the LinkedIn job and share the message payload; 2) frontend will fix the mobile CTA by EOD; 3) analytics to run a replay/backfill to reclassify malformed UTMs where possible and produce pre/post numbers for the KPI deck.

numbers-bot: replay job scheduled (job=8890), ETA ~30m.

liam: Quick sim: if we reassign 320 of the linkedin_org cohort to webinar (using referrer + message_id heuristics), demo-booking rate normalizes to ~4.6%. If we exclude unverified emails, booking rate across verified leads is 5.1%. Will attach the cohort diffs.

sophie: CSV of top 50 linkedin_org rows uploaded to Sales Ops for manual triage. Note: many have email_verified=false; Sales Ops recommends a two-step re-engage before handing to AE.

jana: Perfect. For the KPI note: 1) temporary inflation from LinkedIn automation + malformed UTMs; 2) mobile CTA regression reduced booking funnel hits; 3) corrected metrics will be included in the appendix and we'll call out residual uncertainty for unverified emails.

kevin: I'll post the pre/post numbers here when replay completes. Also adding an alert rule: if any campaign's unverified_email_rate > 20% for 1h, page #growth on-call.

numbers-bot: replay complete (job=8890) 6 logs: reclassified 312 leads -> webinar; errors=0; duration=14m12s.

sophie: Pre: signups=3,640 / webinar=2,920 / demo-book-rate=2.3%. Post (backfill+CTA fix sim): signups=3,640 / webinar_adjusted=3,232 / demo-book-rate_adjusted=4.7% (verified cohort=5.0%). Charts uploaded to KPI deck appendix.

jana: Thanks all. We'll present the corrected numbers and the three-line remediation in Monday's KPI review. If growth-automation needs support rolling back, ping me here. :white_check_mark:
